reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Spotify
reauth_confirm.description: The Spotify login expired or was revoked. Log in again with the same account.

abort.already_configured: This Spotify account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different Spotify account than before.
abort.missing_credentials: Add your Spotify Client ID and Secret under Application Credentials first.
abort.oauth_error: Received invalid token data from Spotify.
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token.

application_credentials.description: Create an app at {developer_dashboard_url} (or use your existing one) and add this Redirect URI: {redirect_url}. Then enter its Client ID and Client Secret here. Note: if you already have a Spotify app, reuse it — apps created after February 2026 get a more limited API (see README).

data.skip_on_block: Skip to the next track after blocking

data_description.media_players: The first player is used by the 'Never this artist/track again' buttons. All players feed the 'Recently played' sensor.
data_description.auto_refresh: Leave OFF while another job still rebuilds the same playlists, or they will overwrite each other.
data_description.shuffle_off: The playlist is already shuffled with artists spread apart. Spotify shuffle makes it worse, and Smart Shuffle adds tracks that bypass every filter.

day.title: Configure {day}
day.description: One item per line. Seeds: {seeds} hand-picked tracks (Spotify links); they bypass all filters and rotate.

data_description.searches: Use genre filters, e.g. 'happy genre:pop'. Bare words like 'focus' attract background music.
data_description.seed_weeks: Empty = general setting. 2 = half of the seeds each week, least recently played first.
data_description.rebuild_now: Runs in the background (about a minute); otherwise the change is used at the next refresh of this day.

blocklists.title: Blocklists
blocklists.description: One per line. Artists: exact name. Genres and words: part of the text (careful with short words, see README).

data_description.block_scripts: Tracks whose title or artist contains these scripts are skipped (search results and own top/recent; not source playlists or seeds).

data.max_per_artist: Max. tracks per artist per day
data.rest_days: Track rest (days) before it may return
data.covers: Set a cover image per day

data_description.playlist_name: Put the word dag between curly braces where the day name should go (the default already does).
data_description.covers: Puts the weekmix cover on each day's playlist once. Requires logging in again once (extra Spotify permission). A cover you set yourself afterwards is left alone.

rebuild.name: Rebuild playlist
rebuild.description: Rebuilds the playlist for a day.

day.name: Day
day.description: Today, all days, or a weekday.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only compute; do not change the playlist.

block_artist.name: Block artist
block_artist.description: Never this artist again; also removes them from all seven playlists.

block_track.name: Block track
block_track.description: Never this track again (any release); also removes it from all seven playlists.

track.name: Track
track.description: Spotify link or URI. Empty = what is playing now.

unblock_artist.name: Unblock artist
unblock_artist.description: Removes an artist from the blocklist.

unblock_track.name: Unblock track
unblock_track.description: Removes a track from the blocklist again.
